The Emperor went to Pujin Pass. The Prince rode light cavalry from Baibi to report in person. Song Jingang seized the moment to besiege Jiangzhou.
柏壁 is Baibi; 蒲津關 is Pujin Pass.

After a feigned retreat, the Prince drove his elite cavalry through their lines and broke them. Song Jingang fled with a light detachment. Yuchi Jingde, Xun Xiang, and Zhang Wansui surrendered; their best troops were absorbed, and Jiezhou was retaken.

When battle was joined the Tang line fell back a little, then the Prince drove his elite cavalry through their lines and broke them. Song Jingang fled with a light detachment. Yuchi Jingde, Xun Xiang, and Zhang Wansui surrendered; their best troops were absorbed, and Jiezhou was retaken.
既戰，小卻 says the Tang troops gave ground slightly, not a feigned retreat.

Earlier, the Huairou monk Gao Tansheng had used a feast the magistrate had prepared as his cover to strike with his disciples and kill the official. He proclaimed himself Emperor of the Great Vehicle, made the nun Jingxuan his Empress Yesu, and adopted the era name Falun. He sent envoys to treat Gao Kaidao as a sworn brother, enfeoffed him as King of Qi, and Kaidao brought his followers over to him.

Earlier, the Huairong monk Gao Tansheng had used a feast the magistrate had prepared as his cover to strike with his disciples and kill the official. He proclaimed himself Emperor of the Great Vehicle, made the nun Jingxuan his Empress Yesu, and adopted the era name Falun. He sent envoys to treat Gao Kaidao as a sworn brother, enfeoffed him as King of Qi, and Kaidao brought his followers over to him.

When Dou Jiande besieged Luo Yi at Youzhou, Yi called for help and Kaidao rode to his relief with two thousand cavalry. Jiande broke off the siege and withdrew. Kaidao then used Yi's envoy to offer surrender. The court appointed him Commander-in-chief of Wei Prefecture, Grand Pillar of State, and Prince of Beiping Commandery, and granted him the surname Li.

Kaidao then used Yi's envoy to offer surrender. The court appointed him Area Commander of Weizhou, Grand Pillar of State, and Prince of Beiping Commandery, and granted him the surname Li.
蔚州總管 is Area Commander of Weizhou (蔚, not 魏).

He appointed Wang Cong Director of the Secretariat and Liu Bin Vice Director, then sent envoys north to treat with the Turk khan Illig. Illig sent the yabgu Song Xiena at the head of cavalry to join him. His army surged in strength, and in less than half a year he held all of Jiande's old territory.

俟斤 is the Turkic title irkin, not yabgu (葉護).

The Emperor put Prince Huaiyang Daoxuan in command of Hebei and sent him with Duke of Yanguo Shi Wanbao against the rebels. They fought at Xiabo and were routed; Daoxuan died on the field and Wanbao escaped on a fast horse. Hebei then rebelled again and went back to the rebels.

原國公 is Duke of Yuanguo.

司馬 here is the staff post of adjutant (sima), not marshal.
